newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The parliament began the discussion of a draft law about social health care.
- The junior coalition party Free Democrats (SZDSZ) initiated official talks with the senior government member Socialists (MSZP) about Hungary's planned agreement with the Vatican.
- The police found the four men who had forced a Danish tourist overcharged in a Budapest restaurant to pay the bill of over one million forints.
- Parliament chairman Zoltan Gal said the police must be more efficient in the fight against organised crime.
